Enclosing complement and self-difference rules compare operands in the same typed/profile-indexed certified ACI quotient, including composed slot invocations, without mutating the source operands; ACI-distinct operators remain barriers. An actual parser-authenticated signature additionally absorbs a declaration-DAG descendant only when every subset-parent branch recursively reaches the carrier; primitive full carriers also absorb exact-type-proved subrelations, while a merely carrier-typed expression has no named subset-carrier authority. Exact same-arity empty relations are subsets of every relation, and plain relational ARROW/JOIN with an authenticated empty operand derive an exact-arity empty result before certification. Boolean laws apply only with concordant literal, formula-opcode-family, immediate operand, and parser-or-derived operator authority. Generic Bool type metadata is not operator provenance, and public semantic mutation revokes an internal derivation token. Relation-valued ITE is retained while its children are traversed; only an authorized exact Boolean ITE expands. Admission checks every alternative in each reachable union component and every temporal phase before branch, absorber, or dualization rewrites. A temporal-looking REF additionally requires one-use parser-issued source/graph/visit/downlink/type/lineage evidence, owner and child-range agreement, exact source arity, an exact source-visit edge bucket with unique contiguous positions and live captured root and child targets, live root-to-source reachability and graph-edge counterparts until a final validated snapshot seal, and one exact nonoverlapping exhaustive owner-issued child partition, plus a globally unique authority identity; metadata-only, unbound, cross-visit, incomplete-bucket, root-removed, child-removed, graph-mutated, wrong-owner, reused, or transplanted references reject. Named arity-zero LET references are the only explicit pre-beta placeholder. Reserved none/univ recognition additionally requires internal parser-factory or derived authority; public metadata cannot mint it, trusted nullary normalization preserves it, and any child mutation revokes it. Child insertion and semantic comparison require one arena/profile; rejected child and CALL-metadata mutations preserve their complete prior state; admission and complete reachable-component freezing share one arena monitor, EGraphNode is a final trusted representation with no producer override dispatch, and the NormalForm publishes frozen only afterward. Saturation preflights the complete reachable closure so another parent cannot mutate a shared frozen descendant or partially rewrite a mutable sibling before rejection. Rewrite-created nodes and snapshots inherit the existing source graph arena even when execution moves across threads, and creation rechecks owner mutability under that arena monitor. Retained-arena cleanup follows child edges and reachable union components but not registration alone; empty and all-null root sets clear both storage layers, and pruned handles become permanently retired, fail admission and semantic reads before traversal, invalidate escaped child views, and release node/child plus cache payload. NormalForm-derived rewrites preserve source-arena ownership, while one shared temporal-tree lifecycle monitor serializes child construction, normalization, admission, complete staging/commit, and recursive freeze. Lean pins the bounded relation ACI laws, equality transport into complement/self-difference, component, temporal, source-visit, root-liveness, child-liveness, exact temporal-child coverage, live-graph, owner-bound seal, atomic publication, transactional mutation, whole-graph mutability, generated-node arena inheritance, all-null closure, serialized lifecycle outcomes, sealed-dispatch, reachability-pruning, authority, and operand-family gates; complete Java-to-Lean mutable-graph refinement remains open. Parser-authorized iden additionally closes exact JOIN identity, exact binary transpose closes involution and binary-product reversal, and exact nested closure closes all four transitive/reflexive fixed points before the snapshot; SAT near misses and standalone finite-path proofs retain their boundaries.
